name: Screen (desktop sampling)
_comment: Shipped default prompt TEXT (empty `values` inherits the built-in Default preset) plus explicit samplers.
Why: the app only sends temperature for a prompt kind when that kind is code-pinned (promptSamplers.ts
PROMPT_SAMPLER_PINS) or when it thinks it's driving the built-in engine (localModelActive = isDesktop() &&
!useCustomEndpoint). The harness reaches the engine over a custom endpoint from a browser, so
localModelActive is false and every UNPINNED kind sent no temperature at all — node-llama-cpp then
defaults to 0 ('Disabled by default'), i.e. greedy decoding. Ollama filled in its Modelfile's 0.7 instead,
so engine-vs-Ollama scores were comparing sampling, not engines.
These pins send the values a real desktop build would resolve: DEFAULT_GEN_TEMPERATURE 0.7 and
DEFAULT_GEN_REPETITION_PENALTY 1.1 for the unpinned kinds. The code-pinned kinds (statUpdates 0.2,
locationChange 0.15, summary 0, thinking 0.4/rep 1) are deliberately absent: their pins already apply on
every endpoint, so they were never part of the discrepancy.
Residual gap vs a real desktop build: top_p 0.9 / top_k 40 / min_p 0 are gated behind localModelActive and
cannot be set from a preset, so the engine uses node-llama-cpp's own defaults for those. Fixed across all
models, so cross-model ranking stays fair; absolute parity with desktop is approximate.
